title: Phase II/III randomized controlled open-label trial to evaluate the efficacy and safety of personalized tissue engineered veins in patients with chronic venous insufficiency
official: Phase II/III randomized controlled open-label trial to evaluate the efficacy and safety of personalized tissue engineered veins in patients with chronic venous insufficiency
summary:
Main objective: To demonstrate the efficacy of P-TEV grafts with valves in the reduction of deep venous valve 
pathology in patients with severe CVI (Disease-modifying efficacy). 

To demonstrate the efficacy of P-TEV grafts with valves in the reduction of clinical signs and 
symptoms of CVI in patients with severe CVI (Clinical efficacy).
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Male or Female patients aged between 18 and 75 years old
2. CVI patients with painful swelling and/or skin changes and/or recurrent leg ulcer despite optimal  conservative treatment for a period according to the Investigator’s judgement
3. Patients with significant femoral deep venous reflux
4. Lab values: INR <1.7 (patient on Warfarin, may repeat the test after anticoagulant change); Platelets ≥ 100 x 109/L; Hemoglobin ≥ 100 g/L; Total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 × upper limit of normal (ULN)  o ASAT ≤ 2.5 × ULN; ALAT ≤ 2.5 × ULN; Lipid profile within acceptable range according to Investigator’s opinion; Clinical chemistry within acceptable range according to Investigator’s opinion
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patients incapable of giving direct or representative written informed consent
2. Patients who plan to participate in other clinical trials or have participated in other clinical trials  during the past 3 months
3. Patients with arterial pathology (ankle-brachial pressure index < 0,9 or > 1,3)
4. Patients with thrombophilia that cannot be controlled with antithrombotic drugs
5. Patients with an active infection requiring systemic antibiotic treatment
6. Patients with clinically significant cardiac disease (NYHA Class III or IV), measured LVEF ≤ 40%  or an acute cardiac event in the past 6 months
7. Patients with uncontrolled hypertension
8. Patients with renal dysfunction eGFR < 45 ml/min
9. Patients with severe hepatic impairment
10. Patients with ongoing immunosuppression, systemic Cortisol treatment etc
11. Less than 3 months since previous ipsilateral venous intervention (e.g. recanalization)
12. Patients unlikely to cooperate fully in the trial and/or with anticipated poor compliance
13. Clinically significant iliocaval stenosis or occlusion
14. Patients with severe SARSCoV-2 virus infection requiring hospitalization during the past 6 months
15. Patients meeting ASA (American Society of Anesthesiologists Classification) ≥ 4
16. Patients with other uncontrolled intercurrent illness that would jeopardize the patient’s safety,  interfere with the objectives of the protocol, or limit the patient’s compliance with study  requirements, as determined by the Investigator together with the Sponsor
17. Non-walking patients or patients with impaired ankle joint function
18. Patients previously organ-transplanted
19. Patients with cancer except in-situ cancer or a five-year recurrence free period after treatment
20. Patients with autoimmune diseases including rheumatoid arthritis, systemic lupus erythematosus  and multiple sclerosis
21. Pregnant or breast-feeding women
22. Patients with ongoing estrogen treatment
23. Patients with a BMI ≥ 38 or a degree of obesity leading to expected difficulty in surgery or motion  according to Investigator’s opinion
